decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to use disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze to control the tempo of the game while deploying aggressive creatures like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent to apply pressure on the opponent. With a combination of removal spells like Fatal Push and disruptive cards like Thoughtseize, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast-paced offense. Additionally, cards like Nihil Spellbomb provide graveyard hate, while Wasteland helps to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, this deck combines aggression with disruption to dominate the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play aggressive Eldrazi creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck also utilizes powerful lands like Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin to ramp into its threats quickly. With a mix of Eldrazi creatures and colorless spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its early aggression and disruption, while also having the flexibility to adapt to different situations with cards like Once Upon a Time and Blast Zone.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with a combination of counter spells like Force of Will and Daze, removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, and disruptive creatures like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to control the board and tempo of the game while also applying pressure with efficient threats. The inclusion of cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student allows for card selection and filtering, ensuring the deck can maintain a fast and aggressive pace throughout the match.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly generate a high storm count in order to cast powerful spells like Tendrils of Agony or Past in Flames for a lethal combo finish. The deck utilizes cards like Infernal Tutor, Lotus Petal, and Dark Ritual to generate mana and draw cards like Preordain and Ponder to find key combo pieces. The use of disruption cards like Duress and Thoughtseize help protect the combo player from opposing disruption, while cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Burning Wish provide additional versatility and resilience to the deck's game plan.

The deck utilizes a combination of fast mana accelerants and creatures to fill the graveyard quickly, before casting spells to win the game in a single turn. By using cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to mill the library and trigger abilities like Dread Return or Thassa's Oracle, the deck aims to win by creating a deck state that will ensure victory in one fell swoop. It also utilizes disruption spells like Cabal Therapy and Pact of Negation to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this Dimir Tempo deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Daze, and Thoughtseize to counter or discard key threats, the deck aims to control the board and protect its own creatures. Cards like Fatal Push and Murktide Regent provide a strong offensive presence, while Nihil Spellbomb and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares offer additional disruption. The deck also includes card draw and filtering with Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency in executing its game plan.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient and evasive threats. By combining disruptive elements like countermagic and discard spells with efficient removal spells, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's development while clocking them with threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower. The deck also utilizes Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to generate card advantage and maintain tempo. With a mana denial package of Wasteland and the ability to generate advantage with Brainstorm and Ponder, the deck seeks to control the game and close out matches quickly.

This deck focuses on generating a high storm count to cast powerful spells like Tendrils of Agony or Galvanic Relay for a game-winning combo. It utilizes cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate mana quickly, along with cards like Brainstorm and Chrome Mox for card advantage. Veil of Summer protects against disruption while cards like Gaea's Will and Echo of Eons provide additional resources and opportunities to build up the storm count. The deck also includes various lands to support the combo strategy and ensure consistency.

This deck focuses on the powerful interaction between Entomb and Reanimate, allowing you to quickly and efficiently bring back powerful creatures from your graveyard. By filling your graveyard with key creatures like Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier, you can easily overwhelm your opponent with fast and strong threats. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect your combo pieces. Overall, the goal is to set up a quick and explosive reanimation strategy while controlling the game with counterspells and removal spells.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by disrupting opponents' strategies with cards like Thoughtseize, Swords to Plowshares, and Prismatic Ending while also maintaining card advantage and board presence with cards like Brainstorm, Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, and Murktide Regent. The deck also includes a mix of creatures and spells to provide additional threats and answers to various situations, all while utilizing efficient mana sources like Polluted Delta and Wasteland to control the tempo of the game.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and It That Heralds the End while disrupting the opponent with cards like Chalice of the Void and Kozilek's Command. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and powerful threats, using additional support from cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Sowing Mycospawn. The deck's mana base is optimized for playing Eldrazi efficiently, with cards like Cavern of Souls and Eye of Ugin helping to cast the powerful creatures as early as possible.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and then bringing them back onto the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The strategy involves using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm to set up the perfect reanimation target, while also having disruption in the form of Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo. The deck also includes some tempo plays like Brazen Borrower and Daze to help control the game until the combo can be assembled.

The addition of Atraxa and Archon of Cruelty provide additional threats and disruption, making this deck a versatile and potent force in the Legacy format.
